_meta.what: Area Specific Loading (ASL): the percentage KPWD adds to Vol 2 finished rates for work outside the Bangalore division (Vol 2 Preface item 6)
_meta.source: KPWD SR 2023-24 Volume 1 (Common SR), section 'Area Specific Loading' — NOT in Volume 2
_meta.how_to_fill: Enter district_id → percent from Vol 1, e.g. "mangaluru": 7.5. Districts left out fall back to the interim regional premium (model/features.py district_cost_multiplier), which is labelled as such in every estimate.
